trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.text: हेलो, मेरा planned surgery है next week. मुझे check करना है कि cashless approve होगा या नहीं. मेरा patient ID PT-2004 है और policy number POL-55504.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and ask for procedure details.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent asks for the procedure and room category.
steps.text: नमस्ते. मैं ज़रूर check कर लेती हूँ. Estimate निकालने के लिए, आपको कौन सा procedure करवाना है और room category क्या होगी?
steps.planner_rationale: Need the procedure and room category to estimate costs before checking policy details.

steps.purpose: Provide procedure and room category with a phonetic STT error.
steps.text: मुझे ACL reconstruction करवाना है और journal ward चाहिए.
steps.clean_text: मुझे ACL reconstruction करवाना है और general ward चाहिए.
steps.model_visible_text: मुझे ACL reconstruction करवाना है और journal ward चाहिए.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent correctly maps the phonetically corrupted word 'journal' to 'general' and fetches the estimate.
steps.planner_rationale: I will infer 'general' from the phonetic error 'journal' and fetch the package estimate.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent asks for verification factors before looking up policy details.
steps.text: Thank you. Policy coverage check करने से पहले, security के लिए क्या आप अपना date_of_birth और registered_pincode confirm कर सकते हैं?
steps.planner_rationale: Must verify customer identity using non-sensitive factors before proceeding with the pre-authorisation request.

steps.text: हाँ, 15th August 1980, और pin code 400001 है.
steps.clean_text: हाँ, 15th August 1980, और pin code 400001 है.
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ, 15th August 1980, और pin code 400001 है.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent calls the verification tool with the provided factors.
steps.planner_rationale: Customer provided DOB and pincode, so I will verify their identity.

steps.purpose: Look up policy coverage and balance.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent looks up the policy coverage using the identifiers provided early in the call, demonstrating Slot Value Recall.
steps.planner_rationale: Need to check policy coverage and remaining balance to see if the 80,000 estimate is fully covered.

steps.purpose: Explain the package estimate and the shortfall due to low balance.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent states the package estimate and the available balance, explaining that there will be a shortfall.
steps.text: आपकी details verify हो गयी हैं. आपके procedure का package_estimate 80,000 rupees है. लेकिन आपकी policy में अभी सिर्फ 45,000 rupees का balance बचा है. तो बाकी का amount आपको pay करना होगा.
steps.planner_rationale: Inform the user that the package estimate exceeds their remaining policy balance, adhering to the balance truth rule.

steps.purpose: Dispute the balance figure based on the total sum insured.
steps.text: एक मिनट, यह कैसे हो सकता है? मेरी policy का sum_insured तो 2 लाख का है. आपने 45,000 कैसे calculate किया? मुझे exact reason बताइए.
steps.clean_text: एक मिनट, यह कैसे हो सकता है? मेरी policy का sum_insured तो 2 लाख का है. आपने 45,000 कैसे calculate किया? मुझे exact reason बताइए.
steps.model_visible_text: एक मिनट, यह कैसे हो सकता है? मेरी policy का sum_insured तो 2 लाख का है. आपने 45,000 कैसे calculate किया? मुझे exact reason बताइए.

steps.purpose: Clarify the difference between sum insured and remaining balance.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent correctly explains that previous claims have reduced the sum insured to the current balance.
steps.text: Sir, आपका total sum_insured 2 लाख rupees ज़रूर है, पर आपके previous claims deduct होने के बाद current available balance 45,000 rupees ही बचा है. हम सिर्फ इस balance तक ही cashless request कर सकते हैं.
steps.planner_rationale: Address the customer's skepticism by explaining the difference between sum insured and remaining balance based on the tool result.

steps.purpose: Accept the explanation and instruct to submit the pre-authorisation for the available balance.
steps.text: अच्छा, पुराने claims... ठीक है, समझ गया. तो आप 45,000 के लिए preauth submit कर दीजिए.
steps.clean_text: अच्छा, पुराने claims... ठीक है, समझ गया. तो आप 45,000 के लिए preauth submit कर दीजिए.
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा, पुराने claims... ठीक है, समझ गया. तो आप 45,000 के लिए preauth submit कर दीजिए.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent submits the preauth request using previously collected identifiers.
steps.planner_rationale: Customer agreed to proceed with the available balance, so I will submit the preauth request using previously collected identifiers.

steps.purpose: Confirm submission and state the decision window without promising approval.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent provides the preauth ID and decision timeframe, explicitly not promising approval.
steps.text: मैंने आपका preauth request submit कर दिया है. Request ID PA-9988 है. Insurer CareIns लगभग 4 घंटे में अपना decision दे देंगे. Balance amount आपको admission के time pay करना होगा.
steps.planner_rationale: Provide the preauth ID and decision timeframe to the customer as per the terminal success condition.

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.
